component.name: VideoItemComponent
component.script:
sub init() m.itemBackground = m.top.findNode("itemBackground") m.itemBackground.opacity = manifestOpacity("guide_item_opacity", 0.8) m.thumbnail = m.top.findNode("thumbnail") m.fallbackIcon = m.top.findNode("fallbackIcon") m.titleLabel = m.top.findNode("titleLabel") m.descLabel = m.top.findNode("descLabel") m.durationLabel = m.top.findNode("durationLabel") m.top.observeField("itemContent", "onContentChanged") end sub
function manifestOpacity(key as string, fallback as float) as float appInfo = createObject("roAppInfo") text = appInfo.getValue(key) if text = invalid or text = "" then return fallback value = text.toFloat() if value < 0 then return 0 if value > 1 then return 1 return value end function
sub onContentChanged() content = m.top.itemContent if content = invalid then return
m.titleLabel.text = content.title m.durationLabel.text = formatDuration(content.metadataLength)
if content.description <> invalid and content.description <> "" m.descLabel.text = content.description else m.descLabel.text = content.url end if
' Handle thumbnail or show local fallback icon if content.HDPosterUrl <> invalid and content.HDPosterUrl <> "" m.thumbnail.uri = content.HDPosterUrl m.thumbnail.visible = true m.fallbackIcon.visible = false else m.thumbnail.visible = false m.fallbackIcon.visible = true end if end sub
function formatDuration(value as dynamic) as string if value = invalid or value < 0 then return "" totalSeconds = int(value) hours = int(totalSeconds / 3600) minutes = int((totalSeconds mod 3600) / 60) seconds = totalSeconds mod 60 secondsText = seconds.toStr() if seconds < 10 then secondsText = "0" + secondsText minutesText = minutes.toStr() if hours > 0 and minutes < 10 then minutesText = "0" + minutesText if hours > 0 then return hours.toStr() + ":" + minutesText + ":" + secondsText return minutesText + ":" + secondsText end function
